audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 at 52.40% WR over 1584 games — Aurora wins level 1 poke and everything from 6 onward in a duel; TF's windows are level 2 waveclear and the map game. Packet flags the chart as contradicting the 52.4% TF win rate, but the packet chart and content layer agree with each other, and TF's WR edge coming from roams rather than lane stages is consistent with a lane-lost/map-won read; no change to diff.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content and packet on six of seven rows: full read Aurora/Aurora/Aurora/Aurora then Skill/Skill/Skill, while content win[] and the packet both read Aurora, TF, Skill, Skill, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content mislabels Aurora's abilities: spikes[0].text and 'mid' call her backhop 'Spirit Abjuration (E)' — Spirit Abjuration is her healing PASSIVE; the E is The Weirding (damage, slow, backhop). spikes[1] credits her R with 'displaces you and heals her' — the heal is the passive, not the R. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits. Missing interaction: her passive spirit healing makes Grievous Wounds timing matter in extended trades.
audit.why: Kit: W Across the Veil 22/21/20/19/18s (dash + invisibility), E The Weirding 15/14/13/12/11s (slow zone, backhop), R Between Worlds 140/120/100s (leap, shockwave slow, teleport zone), P heals via exorcised spirits. TF W 6s.
audit.corrected: Ability names corrected, cooldowns field now carries 22/18, 15s and 6s, anti-heal (Oblivion Orb before extended fights) added to 'late'.

notes: Chart: content win[] matched the packet on all seven rows, so full sides were edited alone (rows 1-6), with whys rewritten in the same group; row 0 already agreed. Ratings were left untouched: the rating scale's direction is inconsistent across existing rows (Aurora-favoured row 0 carries 7/10 while TF-favoured rows elsewhere carry 6/10), and guessing the convention risked making rows worse — flagging for the QA pass. Packet's own defect note ('chart contradicts 52.4% TF WR') was judged not actionable: packet and content agree, and TF winning via roams while losing lane stages is coherent for a global-ult champion. Ability-name errors fixed: 'Spirit Abjuration (E)' -> The Weirding (E) in spikes[0] and 'mid'; R 'displaces and heals' corrected to leap/slow zone with passive spirit healing. Rod-of-Ages reference aligned to the page's Lich Bane itemization. Anti-heal missing interaction placed in 'late' (Oblivion Orb before extended fights). sectionsMissing (templated, not grounded): tradeGood, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d.
